title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: email resolution answers customer emails without creating a case
summary: Hold: the briefing reports automation APIs as undocumented even though Microsoft publishes writable email-agent and line-of-business automation settings. It also tells administrators to use the case-resolution review setting for email resolution without establishing that this setting controls the new email workflow. The roadmap dates, preview qualification and consumption-billing description are supported.

claims.fix: Replace the blanket API absence with: 'Dataverse documents PATCH /msdyn_agentcopilotsettings(msdyn_agentcopilotsettingid), with the writable Boolean msdyn_emailresolutionagentenabled (Is Email Management Agent Enabled). The reference does not explicitly map it to the UI toggle or document application-user selection.'
